name: Multimodal Retinal Image Dataset for Diabetic Retinopathy Detection
description: A large-scale multimodal retinal imaging dataset including color fundus photography, optical coherence tomography, and ultrawide-field fundus imaging, with detailed lesion-level annotations and severity grades for diabetic retinopathy and diabetic macular edema. It serves as a benchmark for evaluating AI models in clinical retinal disease diagnosis.
reputation: A newly introduced clinical multimodal retinal dataset with promising benchmark value, but still early in terms of broad public adoption and standardized leaderboards.
notes: Unifies multiple retinal imaging modalities with fine-grained clinical annotations to benchmark AI diagnostic performance.
